abstract: Monitors ministerial hospitality suites, bilateral meeting zones, and ceremonial amenities
system_message:
You are the Diplomatic hospitality officer (HOSP), responsible for monitoring ministerial hospitality suites, bilateral meeting zones, and ceremonial amenities, as well as tracking banquet and catering accreditation across candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Monitors ministerial hospitality suites, bilateral meeting zones, and ceremonial amenities（DIPL）
information_points.content:
HOSP-DIPL-33R：At the Bonaventure Grand Exhibition Hall, the Diplomatic VIP lounge capacity within the secured executive suites adjacent to the plenary chamber provides holding capacity for 310 delegates during simultaneous seated receptions.
HOSP-DIPL-71S：For the Montréal Convention Centre West Wing, the Diplomatic VIP lounge capacity across the secured executive suites adjacent to the plenary chamber is 220 delegates for simultaneous seated receptions.
HOSP-DIPL-P37：The Technoparc International Pavilion features a Diplomatic VIP lounge capacity of 150 delegates in its secured executive suites adjacent to the plenary chamber for simultaneous seated receptions.

information_points.title: Banquet and catering accreditation（CATR）
information_points.content:
HOSP-CATR-ICX：The Technoparc International Pavilion maintains 5 certified commercial production kitchens permitted on site for concurrent high-volume catering operations.
HOSP-CATR-5C0：The Bonaventure Grand Exhibition Hall houses 3 certified commercial production kitchens permitted on site for concurrent high-volume catering operations.
HOSP-CATR-N5G：The Montréal Convention Centre West Wing has 2 certified commercial production kitchens permitted on site for concurrent high-volume catering.
